definition: A graph of a journey, with time across and distance from the start up; it is also called a distance–time graph.
A straight-line graph for changing an amount in one unit or currency into another, such as pounds into dollars.
How much one quantity changes for each one unit of another, such as km per hour; on a straight-line graph it is the gradient.
A graph with time across and speed up: its gradient is the acceleration and the area under it is the distance travelled.
The rate of change of speed, in a unit such as m/s$^2$; slowing down is called deceleration and is given as a positive number.
